Work / GPS Alarm

On Google Play

GPS Alarm

Set your stop and relax on the bus. It wakes you before you arrive, even offline.

Get it on Google Play →
Context
Our own app
Type
Android app
Stack
Kotlin, Android
Status
Live on Google Play

The problem

On long bus and train rides it is easy to fall asleep or miss a stop, especially on a route you do not know.

What we built

Pick a destinationDrop a pin on the map.
Set the distanceChoose how early to wake up, for example 500 metres before.
Works offlineUses the phone's GPS, no data connection needed.
Simple and freeNo account and no ads.

How it works

The app watches the phone's location in the background and sounds the alarm when you enter the circle around your stop.

Status, honestly

Published and free on Google Play.
